description: fx2-cmix fork with deterministic MediaWiki structural sidecar contexts plus extra structural matchers keyed by title/template, numeric/url, entity recency, and template slot contexts
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Built from external/fx2-cmix with GCC using SEED=923, UPDATE_LIMIT=3000, and SIDECAR_EXTRA_MATCH. cmix.bin.gz and english.dic.gz are counted by the harness.
